reviews.title: This is such a letdown oh my lord
reviews.text: This game is really pay to win, i remember half of the stuff being free? I downloaded this again because of nostalgia, this is such a bummer, please let people play this game normally without having to pay, you could let people have more outfits, unlock features, and the only thing you have to pay for, is extra addons that don’t affect the gameplay, yes I’m a grown-ish person writing a bad review about a Barbie game, but uh.. I don’t really care, this used to be absolutely my favorite game, it’s so disappointing..
